principle_violations.reason: The Order class is handling order management (items, quantities, prices) and also should handle payment status. This mixes responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate order management from payment processing to adhere to the Single Responsibility Principle. Create a separate class for Payment that can handle order payments.

principle_violations.reason: The Order class needs to be modified if different types of items or pricing strategies are added in the future.
principle_violations.suggestion: Implement a way to handle different item types and their corresponding pricing strategies without modifying the Order class. Consider creating an interface for item management.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
